name.description: Human-readable bulk name visible in the panel and reports

bulkType.description:
Sending mode:
- STANDARD uses common 'message'
- PERSONALIZED uses per-recipient 'content'
- PARAMETRIZED is reserved for advanced templates.

bulkVariant.description:
Allowed variants for partners: ECO, FULL, PRO, INTER, VOICE.
UI mapping: BASIC → ECO, DYNAMIC → FULL, UNIQUE → PRO, INTERNATIONAL → INTER, VOICE → VOICE.

bulkPriority.description: Priority of processing. NORMAL by default; ALERT prioritizes sending (requires administrator permission).

sender.description: Sender name. For some variants alias may be normalized depending on route. Nullable for platforms that do not require sender (e.g. FR).

message.description: Message body used for STANDARD bulks. For PERSONALIZED/PARAMETRIZED, use recipients[].content.

groupIds.description: Optional identifiers of predefined recipients groups. When provided, recipients from these groups will be merged with 'recipients' list.

items.description: Optional identifiers of predefined recipients groups. When provided, recipients from these groups will be merged with 'recipients' list.

sendDate.description:
Planned sending time in ISO 8601 with timezone,
e.g. 2026-06-10T10:00:00+02:00

sendEndDate.description: Optional end of sending window in ISO 8601 with timezone. If provided earlier than sendDate + configured minimum interval, it will be normalized to that minimum.

recipients.description:
List of recipients.
For PERSONALIZED/PARAMETRIZED, provide content per recipient (recipients[].content).
